'''Corellian Arms''' was a subsidiary company of the mega corporation, [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Corellian Arms was a weapons manufacturer<ref name="TCSWE" /> and produced the [[CR-2 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|CR-2 heavy blaster pistol]]. They focused on personal weapons and worked solely on contract. The company preferred to modify existing designs instead of creating original models.<ref name="NEGWT" />

By [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], only one production facility remained in operation, on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
